summary: Commercial Vehicle Group, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register up to $25 million of common stock for sale under a Capital on Demand Sales Agreement with JonesTrading Institutional Services LLC as sales agent. Shares are offered in at-the-market transactions under Rule 415(a)(4). The agent receives up to 3.0% commission and will use commercially reasonable efforts to sell on behalf of the company. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown/ATM program, not a special situation.
